clause.scope_note: Commercial Terms scope Mistral AI Products; excludes individual consumers, addressed to separate consumer terms.
clause.condition_explanation: Mistral AI Products covers the listed websites, products, software, services, and technologies offered by Mistral AI.

review.reason: Line 3 defines the commercial Customer as the organization, company, or other entity represented and identifies the covered Mistral AI Products.

clause.scope_note: Directs individual consumers to other terms; does not state those terms’ rules.
clause.condition_explanation: The applicable consumer terms depend on where the individual resides.

review.reason: Line 5 directs individual consumers to separate consumer terms based on residence; the anchor correctly avoids importing their content.

clause.scope_note: Acceptance of these Terms and referenced policies/terms forms a binding agreement as of acceptance.
clause.condition_explanation: Acceptance occurs by clicking an agreement control, executing a referencing Order Form, or otherwise accessing or using Products on Customer’s behalf. Referenced terms are not supplied in full.

review.reason: Line 7 lists the three acceptance routes, represents the acceptor’s authority, incorporates the specified terms, and makes the agreement binding as of acceptance.

clause.scope_note: Access to or use of Products on infrastructure Customer owns or controls; subject also to Order Form and Customer Infrastructure Additional Terms.
clause.condition_explanation: Customer Infrastructure includes private servers or private cloud. Additional Terms are referenced but not supplied.

review.reason: Line 10 requires express Mistral AI authorization in an Order Form and identifies the additional governing documents.

clause.scope_note: Use on infrastructure owned by a third-party partner authorized to resell or market Products; subject to partner terms and, unless otherwise specified therein, these Terms and Partner Served - Deployment Terms.
clause.condition_explanation: The partner’s applicable ordering documentation must expressly authorize access or use. Referenced deployment and partner terms are not supplied.

review.reason: Line 12 requires express partner authorization in applicable ordering documentation and states the partner-terms qualification.

clause.scope_note: Applies to Products on Mistral AI Infrastructure, including uses not on Customer or Partner Infrastructure.
clause.condition_explanation: The clause specifies governing terms, not a separate express grant. The referenced Additional Terms are not supplied.

review.reason: Line 14 identifies the applicable Terms and Additional Terms and defines the covered infrastructure by exclusion of Customer and Partner Infrastructure.

clause.scope_note: Customer is solely responsible for specified activities, including End User actions, and for obtaining required End User consents or permissions.
clause.condition_explanation: Scope includes Customer Account and End User Accounts, Customer Infrastructure, and Customer Offerings. Definitions appear in the supplied definition context.

obligation_items.content: Obtain appropriate End User consents or permissions required for Customer’s compliance with these Terms.
obligation_items.trigger: When such consent or permission is required for Customer’s compliance with these Terms.

review.reason: Line 16 assigns Customer responsibility for the specified activities and expressly requires obtaining End User permissions or consents needed for compliance.

clause.scope_note: Separate-workspace access apart from Customer Account; alternative acceptance paths.
clause.condition_explanation: Affiliate is defined in the paragraph by control, being controlled, or common control.

obligation_items.content: Separately accept these Terms or enter into a separate Order Form with Mistral AI.
obligation_items.object: Separate-workspace access to Mistral AI Products
obligation_items.trigger: If the Customer Affiliate wishes to access Products on a workspace separate from Customer Account.

review.reason: Line 18 requires separate acceptance or a separate Order Form for Affiliate access on a separate workspace.

clause.scope_note: Express license to access and use Mistral AI Products; transfer exception refers to Section 14.2 and sublicensing exception is for End Users.
clause.condition_explanation: Compliance with Terms is a condition. The referenced assignment provision is not supplied; the stated End User exception does not expand beyond its terms.

review.reason: Line 21 expressly grants a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable access-and-use license, subject to compliance and the stated assignment and End User exceptions.

clause.scope_note: Restriction covers attempts directed at Products and attempts using Output or modified Output; excludes the restriction to the extent prohibited by applicable law.
clause.condition_explanation: Underlying components include algorithms, weights, or systems. The applicable-law exception limits the prohibition.

obligation_items.content: Do not attempt to reverse engineer, decompile, or otherwise discover Product source code or underlying components, including by using Output or modified Output.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.object: Mistral AI Products, including their source code and underlying components
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever such an attempt is not to an extent that applicable law prohibits this restriction.

review.reason: Line 31 prohibits the listed attempts, including those using Output or modified Output, except to the extent the restriction is prohibited by applicable law.

clause.scope_note: Restriction permits extraction methods allowed through Products in accordance with Terms.
clause.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies only to extraction by a method outside that permitted route.

obligation_items.content: Do not use a method to extract Product content except as permitted through Products in accordance with these Terms.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.trigger: When the extraction method is not permitted through Products in accordance with these Terms.

review.reason: Line 37 prohibits extraction by methods other than those permitted through the Products in accordance with the Terms.

clause.scope_note: Prohibits integrating or combining Vibe with Customer’s third-party offerings, including software, hardware, or other technology; also restricts third-party access absent authorization or a Terms exception.
clause.condition_explanation: Prior written authorization or an express exception under these Terms allows the otherwise restricted conduct.

obligation_items.content: Do not integrate or combine Vibe with products offered to third parties, including software, hardware, or other technology, without prior written authorization.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.trigger: When integration or combination is proposed and prior written authorization is absent.

obligation_items.content: Do not grant a third party access to Products without prior written authorization or an exception provided under these Terms.
obligation_items.actor: Customer and persons Customer permits, including End Users
obligation_items.object: Third-party access to Mistral AI Products
obligation_items.trigger: When third-party access is granted and neither prior written authorization nor a Terms exception applies.

review.reason: Line 41 restricts Vibe integration or combination with third-party offerings and separately restricts third-party access, with the stated authorization or Terms exceptions.

clause.scope_note: Customer must maintain and enforce substantially equivalent Use Restrictions with End Users.
clause.condition_explanation: This is an express duty concerning End Users; Section 2.2 restrictions are stated in lines 25–41.

obligation_items.content: Maintain and enforce with End Users restrictions substantially equivalent to those in Section 2.2.
obligation_items.object: End User use of Mistral AI Products and Outputs
obligation_items.trigger: For End Users subject to Customer’s access or use arrangements.

review.reason: Line 43 expressly requires Customer to maintain and enforce substantially equivalent Section 2.2 restrictions with End Users.

clause.scope_note: Beta Products may be made available at Mistral AI’s discretion solely for Customer’s internal evaluation and testing; third-party distribution or access is prohibited.
clause.condition_explanation: Beta availability is discretionary. Mistral AI may suspend or terminate Beta access at any time in its sole discretion. The paragraph’s as-is and risk statements are disclaimers, not extracted duties.

review.reason: Line 45 limits Beta Product use to Customer’s internal evaluation and testing and leaves third-party distribution or access to the separately modeled express prohibition.
